mentions.name: Wildloop
mentions.description: This is an ecosystem for web app development comprising 12 libraries and tools, most of which are stable though some are still in flux, aimed at improving how web apps are built.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on my vision for a better web app development ecosystem. https://wildloop.dev/

It currently exists of 12 libraries/tool, most of which are pretty stable by now, though some are still very much in flux.
